idea-plugin.name: Local AI Commit
idea-plugin.description:
Local AI Commit Generator for IntelliJ IDEA

Generates structured, conventional commit messages using local LLMs via JetBrains Koog.

  • Multi-Root Git Support: Full visualization and diff extraction for main projects and nested submodules.
  • Local LLM Direct Connection: Connect directly to your local LLM (e.g. Llama/Ollama) with real-time streaming tokens.
  • Smart Token Budgeting & Chunking: Bottom-up directory tree chunking based on dynamically computed context window limits.
  • Repetition Loop Detection: Real-time loop prevention and deduplication.
  • Pre-Commit Actions: Optional rearrange code, reformat code, and optimize imports before commit.
